typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ATTRIBUTE_TYPE as string,
		PROCESSING_ORG_ID as integer,
		LE_ATTRIBUTE_ID as integer,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		VERSION_NUM as integer,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ROLE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ATTRIBUTE_TYPE as string,
		PROCESSING_ORG_ID as integer,
		LE_ATTRIBUTE_ID as integer,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		VERSION_NUM as integer,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ROLE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ATTRIBUTE_TYPE,
		PROCESSING_ORG_ID,
		LE_ATTRIBUTE_ID,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		VERSION_NUM,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ROLE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
